versions.changelog:
Initial release of Alibaba Cloud OOS ChatOps Agent.

- Enables natural language management of Alibaba Cloud resources (ECS, RDS, VPC, SLB, etc.) and O&M automation via a single agent script.
- Enforces strict use of scripts/call_oos_chatops_agent.py for all resource queries and operations; no other tools permitted.
- Supports conversational context with session management for multi-turn queries.
- Provides structured PIPE-mode output, ensuring answers are only taken from verified output sections.
- Includes robust credential security guidance and troubleshooting instructions.
- Allows configurable region and timeout for customized queries and batch operations.
